$Comment: The king's ice ray thrown from his RIGHT hand (2026-10-21, one-hand throws). Same bolt as Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Ray_Freezing (Parent), only the spawn point at the right hand: SpawnOffset is relative to his eyes and turned by his look, forward is -Z, +X = right. The parent keeps its own offset because the player's ice ray rune uses it. 2026-10-21 (playtest: some bolts went into the ground in front of a short target): SpawnOffset Y is 0. HeadMotionAim corrects its aim for the spawn point with ProjectileComponent.computeStartOffset, which subtracts SpawnOffset.Y (it takes +Y as DOWN), while the spawn itself (ProjectileConfig.getCalculatedOffset) adds it (+Y = up). With Y -0.45 (hand height) the aim thought the bolt left 0.45 ABOVE the eyes while it left 0.45 BELOW, so it flew about 0.9 below the aim line. Only Y 0 agrees on both sides; X (side) agrees, so the hand side stays. 2026-10-21 (playtest: the left-hand ray missed even a target standing still): SpawnOffset X is 0 here. The ray's Attack root may carry only one AimingReference (the right-hand bolt), so HeadMotionAim corrects the aim for X +0.45 on BOTH throws; a left bolt leaving at -0.45 flew 0.9 blocks beside the target. With X 0 on both hands the correction is right for either; which hand throws shows in the animation. 2026-10-22 sounds (SFX_AT_Ice_King_* events, rule: each sound on its exact moment): Ice_Ray_Shot as the bolt leaves the hand (LaunchWorldSoundEventId: plays on the launch tick).
